scripts.build:prod: VITE_BUILD_FLAVOR=prod tsc && VITE_BUILD_FLAVOR=prod vite build --mode production
scripts.build:trial: VITE_BUILD_FLAVOR=trial tsc && VITE_BUILD_FLAVOR=trial vite build --mode trial
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:prod: npm run build:prod && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:trial: npm run build:trial && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:copy: npm run build && npx cap copy
scripts.android:build: bash -c 'export JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21) && export GRADLE_USER_HOME=$PWD/.gradle-user-home && npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon'
scripts.android:build:prod: bash -c 'export JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21) && export GRADLE_USER_HOME=$PWD/.gradle-user-home && npm run cap:sync:prod && cd android && ./gradlew clean assembleDebug --no-daemon && cd .. && cp -f android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ./E6B-CX3-debug.apk'
scripts.android:build:trial: bash -c 'export JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21) && export GRADLE_USER_HOME=$PWD/.gradle-user-home && npm run cap:sync:trial && cd android && ./gradlew clean assembleDebug --no-daemon && cd .. && cp -f android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ./E6B-CX3-debug-TRIAL.apk'
scripts.android:release: bash -c 'export JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21) && export GRADLE_USER_HOME=$PWD/.gradle-user-home && npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease --no-daemon'
scripts.android:bundle: bash -c 'export JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21) && export GRADLE_USER_HOME=$PWD/.gradle-user-home && npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease --no-daemon'
scripts.ios:build:prod: npm run build:prod && npx cap sync ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath ios/build -quiet 2>&1 | tail -10
scripts.ios:build:trial: npm run build:trial && npx cap sync ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath ios/build -quiet 2>&1 | tail -10
